item.description:
**Important:** SnapOCR now runs in the App Sandbox. OCR history from earlier versions is not carried over. Your settings are kept.
**重要:** SnapOCR は App Sandbox で動作するようになりました。以前のバージョンの OCR 履歴は引き継がれません。設定は引き継がれます。
## What's Changed * fix: address code review findings and enable App Sandbox in distributed builds by @shiroemons in https://github.com/shiroemons/snapocr/pull/1
## New Contributors * @shiroemons made their first contribution in https://github.com/shiroemons/snapocr/pull/1
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/shiroemons/snapocr/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
